# Nearby Calls

> Done-for-you Google Business Profile management for local businesses in the United States, by Sportsman Creative (Springfield, MO). We optimize and actively grow Google Business Profiles — optimization, Google posts, geo-tagged photos, automated review requests, AI review responses, social posting, and monthly reporting — so local businesses get more visibility, more 5-star reviews, and more customer calls.

## Pricing
- Setup + first full month: $197 one time (normally $497)
- Ongoing service: $497/month starting after the first month
- No contracts, cancel anytime
- 30-Day Visibility Guarantee: if Google Business Profile visibility hasn't improved in the first 30 days, the $197 is refunded
